---
title: "Publications"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

# ---- config -------------------------------------------------------------
me <- "Yanwan Zhu"

type_order <- c("journal_article", "conference_paper",
                "book_chapter", "thesis", 
                "preprint", "under_review", "in_prep")

type_headings <- c("journal_article"  = "Journal Articles",
                   "conference_paper" = "Conference Papers",
                   "book_chapter"     = "Book Chapters",
                   "thesis"     = "Thesis/Dissertation",
                   "under_review"     = "Under Review",
                   "in_prep"   = "In Preparation",
                   "preprint"         = "Preprints")

# ---- read and validate --------------------------------------------------
pubs <- read.csv("publications.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                 na.strings = c("", "NA"), check.names = TRUE)

pubs$type <- tolower(trimws(pubs$type))

bad <- setdiff(unique(pubs$type), type_order)
if (length(bad)) {
  stop("Unknown type(s) in publications.csv: ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "))
}

no_me <- !grepl(me, pubs$authors, fixed = TRUE)
if (any(no_me)) {
  warning("Your name not found in authors for: ",
          paste(pubs$title[no_me], collapse = "; "))
}

# ---- helpers ------------------------------------------------------------
format_authors <- function(x) {
  a <- trimws(strsplit(x, ";")[[1]])
  a <- ifelse(a == me, paste0("**", a, "**"), a)
  if (length(a) == 1) return(a)
  paste0(paste(a[-length(a)], collapse = ", "), ", and ", a[length(a)])
}

meta_line <- function(r) {
  parts <- c(
    if (!is.na(r$publication)) paste0("*", r$publication, "*"),
    if (!is.na(r$year))        as.character(r$year)
  )
  if (!length(parts)) return("")
  paste0(paste(parts, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
}

button <- function(label, url) {
  sprintf('<a class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>',
          url, label)
}

buttons <- function(r) {
  links <- c(
    if (!is.na(r$doi))          button("DOI", paste0("https://doi.org/", r$doi)),
    if (!is.na(r$preprint_url)) button("Preprint", r$preprint_url),
    if (!is.na(r$pdf_url))      button("PDF", r$pdf_url),
    if (!is.na(r$github_url))   button("Code", r$github_url)
  )
  if (!length(links)) return("")
  paste0('<p class="pub-links">', paste(links, collapse = " "), "</p>\n")
}

# ---- render -------------------------------------------------------------
for (ty in type_order) {
  rows <- pubs[pubs$type == ty, ]
  if (!nrow(rows)) next

  yr <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rows$year))
  yr[is.na(yr)] <- Inf
  rows <- rows[order(-yr), ]

  cat("\n## ", type_headings[[ty]], "\n\n", sep = "")

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
    r <- rows[i, ]
    cat("**", r$title, "**  \n", sep = "")
    cat(format_authors(r$authors), "  \n", sep = "")
    cat(meta_line(r))
    cat(buttons(r))
    cat("\n")
  }
}
```
